definitions.gloss: food simmered and bound with beaten egg
definitions.explanation: A cooking style in which beaten egg is poured over ingredients simmering in a seasoned broth and cooked until just set, binding everything together. Also the dish made this way, such as noodles or vegetables finished with egg.

examples.japanese: {卵|たまご}とじうどんを⟦{頼|たの}んだ→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧。
⟦{残|のこ}った→残る：01187_nokoru⟧⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{卵|たまご}とじにした。
examples.english: I cooked the leftover vegetables with beaten egg.

examples.japanese: {卵|たまご}とじは⟦{火|ひ}→火：02248_hi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{止|と}める→止める：00678_tomeru⟧⟦タイミング→タイミング：17683_taimingu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大事|だいじ}→大事：01253_daiji⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{半熟|はんじゅく}→半熟：11935_hanjuku⟧のうちに⟦{仕上|しあ}げる→仕上げる：04664_shiageru⟧とおいしい。
examples.english: With egg-bound dishes the timing of turning off the heat matters; they taste best finished while the egg is still soft.

notes:
From ⟦{卵|たまご}→卵：02222_tamago⟧ (egg) and とじ, from ⟦{綴|と}じる→綴じる：19583_tojiru⟧ (to bind, to fasten). The same technique gives ⟦{親子丼|おやこどん}→親子丼：17621_oyakodon⟧ and カツ{丼|どん} their topping. Often used before another noun: {卵|たまご}とじ{丼|どん}, {卵|たまご}とじうどん.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {卵|たまご}とじにする: to finish with beaten egg
- {卵|たまご}とじうどん / そば: udon / soba with egg
- ⟦ニラ→ニラ：11111_nira⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{卵|たまご}とじ: garlic chives bound with egg

RELATED WORDS:
